resources.string: Block or cap Shorts and Reels
Keep the apps. Control the short videos.
Turn on DayKit’s Short video blocker in Android Accessibility settings so it can detect Shorts and Reels viewers.
Block Shorts and Reels completely or set a daily time allowance while keeping the rest of each app open.

DayKit uses Accessibility to recognize Shorts and Reels in the apps you select, track your daily short-video allowance on your device, and automatically return you to Home or the previous screen when blocked or when your daily limit is reached. Screen content is processed on your device and is never saved or shared.
Allow DayKit to detect short videos?
